title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Catagbacan, Loon, Province of Bohol, to Be Known as the Gov. Jacinto C. Borja National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in the Municipality of Catagbacan, Loon, Province of Bohol, to Be Known as the Gov. Jacinto C. Borja National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Thị trấn Catagbacan, Loon, Tỉnh Bohol được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Gov. Jacinto C. Borja
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Catagbacan, Loon, จังหวัด Bohol ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Gov. Jacinto C. Borja
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Kotamadya Catagbacan, Loon, Provinsi Bohol dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Gov. Jacinto C. Borja
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Catagbacan, Loon, Wilayah Bohol dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Gov. Jacinto C. Borja

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in the Municipality of Catagbacan, Loon, Province of Bohol, to be known as the Gov. Jacinto C. Borja National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
